Package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.bucket

Class TestBucketCacheEmptyPersistence

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.bucket.TestBucketCacheEmptyPersistence
public class TestBucketCacheEmptyPersistence extends Object
Tests for HBASE-29857: BucketCache recovery should gracefully handle empty or truncated persistence files instead of throwing NullPointerException.

These tests verify that the cache recovers gracefully when the persistence file contains only magic bytes without actual cache data. The fix adds null checks that throw IOException instead of allowing NullPointerException to propagate.
